name: pin-cleaner
description: Chrome extension: clean and curate Pinterest

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf build pin-cleaner.zip && mkdir -p build/pin-cleaner && cp -R extension/ build/pin-cleaner/ && cd build && zip -qr ../pin-cleaner.zip pin-cleaner -x "*/.*" && cd .. && rm -rf build
scripts.package:store: npm run build && rm -f pin-cleaner-store.zip && cd extension && zip -qr ../pin-cleaner-store.zip . -x ".*" -x "*/.*"
